description.text: The second expansion of the MEGA series, released on 26 September 2025. Mega Charizard X ex leads it, turning a large amount of Fire Energy into great damage with its attack Inferno X, with Firebreather and Oricorio ex's Ability to get that attack ready. From this set ordinary Pokémon ex, which give up two Prize cards, came back to the series' expansions beside Mega Evolution Pokémon ex: here Oricorio ex, Rotom ex, Mismagius ex and Empoleon ex, with Mega Sharpedo ex, Mega Heracross ex and Mega Lopunny ex. They come with Grimsley's Move, which looks through seven cards of the deck for a Darkness Pokémon and can put it straight into play even if it is not a Basic Pokémon, and Dawn. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 80, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Trainer cards, among them Ignition Energy, the first Special Energy at Super Rare, Special Art Rare cards, and Mega Charizard X ex as a Mega Ultra Rare, gilded over the whole card. In English most of its cards came out in Phantasmal Flames in November 2025.
